articles.title: Time to accept ‘hard truths’ so trust can be rebuilt: General Assembly president
articles.summary: The UN’s survival for 80 years is not, by itself, proof of success, and now, the institution must confront painful truths if it hopes to rebuild public trust, said Khalilur Rahman, president of the General Assembly’s 81st session on Tuesday.

articles.title: Guterres: ‘Cracks have become canyons’ as world faces four tests of power
